The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. The first thing you notice is how lightweight it is - super easy to carry around, perfect for travel, school, or just moving between rooms. The Willow Green color is unique and stylish, definitely stands out from the usual black/gray laptops. Performance-wise, it handles everyday tasks just fine: web browsing, Office apps, streaming, and some light multitasking. The 16GB RAM is nice to have - not blazing fast like higher-end machines, but it helps things run smoother when you have multiple tabs or apps open. Storage is also decent for documents, media, and basic software. A pleasant surprise was finding it comes with a free trial of Office 365, which is handy if you use Word, Excel or outlook. Now, yes - the screen resolution isn\'t top of the line, but honestly, at this price you can\'t expect 2K or 4k. For emails, documents, and YouTube, it\'s perfectly fine. Battery life is average - enough for a few hours of use, but not an all-day machine. And like with most electronics, over time the battery won\'t hold charge as well, so it\'s something to keep in mind. Overall, it\'s not meant to be a powerhouse, but if you\'re looking for a budget-friendly, ultra-portable laptop that just gets the job done without weighing you down, this is an excellent choice.\n\n[More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0))\n\nThank you for your feedback\n\nSorry, there was an error\n\nSorry we couldn\'t load the review\n\n### Top reviews from the United States\n\n \n\n#### There was a problem filtering reviews. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games and AI workloads with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDS for a total of 2TB storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. The redesigned Microsoft Store makes it easier to look for supported apps.\n\nUPC: 198157049147\n\n#### Items Included\n\n- Lenovo 16" Legion Pro 7i Gaming Laptop\n- Power Adapter\n- Office Trial & Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and 2TB of M.2 SSD storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, you can enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, you can enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games and AI workloads with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDS for a total of 2TB storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and 2TB of M.2 SSD storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, you can enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games and AI workloads with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDS for a total of 2TB storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. The redesigned Microsoft Store makes it easier to look for supported apps.\n\nUPC: 198157049147\n\n#### Items Included\n\n- Lenovo 16" Legion Pro 7i Gaming Laptop\n- Power Adapter\n- Office Trial & Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and 2TB of M.2 SSD storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, you can enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games and AI workloads with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDS for a total of 2TB storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and 2TB of M.2 SSD storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, you can enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games and AI workloads with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDS for a total of 2TB storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and 2TB of M.2 SSD storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes.\n\n16" OLED Display\n\nThe 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, you can enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i.\n\nStay Connected for Online Play\n\nWhether you\'re playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller.\n\nWindows 11 Home\n\nMicrosoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. Add 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 SSDs for storage, and you\'ll be able to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system.\n\nIntel Core i9 Performance\n\nThe system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz.\n\nNVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics\n\nThe dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay.
